## Checklist

- [ ] Merged the latest `main` into this branch **locally** (`git fetch origin && git merge origin/main`)
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New or moved files are in `INDEX.md`, and there's a new entry in `log/` (`python tools/new.py log …`)
- [ ] Experiment pages are updated with run dir, result and verdict
- [ ] New dependencies were added with `uv add`, and both `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` are committed
- [ ] Merge with **"Create a merge commit"** (not squash), so this branch can keep going afterwards
